perception.plainEnglish: Five times a second the hunter looks. A wall stops the look. A loud bottle uses that same look instead of growing a second brain.
perception.whyGame: Tracing every frame makes every idle hunter expensive, and a second audio brain will not share the Alert flag the stalk already reads.

expansions.title: A bottle
expansions.detail: The bottle calls Sense. It does not own a private alert float.

expansions.title: Darkness
expansions.detail: A failed trace leaves Alert alone. Darkness is a miss, not a special case in Tick.

expansions.title: Glimpse
expansions.detail: A short clear trace sets Alert to 1. The stalk lesson decides what to do with that.

quiz.prompt: How often does the hunter run Sense in this lesson?
choices: About five times a second, from a timer armed at spawn
Only when the player presses use
Only at the moment the level finishes loading
quiz.why: 0.2 seconds is five times a second.

quiz.prompt: Graph_Sense_tpl_perception_sense traces and may set Alert. What does a blocked trace do?
quiz.why: A wall is a miss.

quiz.prompt: A bottle smashes. Which event should raise Alert?
choices: The same Sense event the eyes use
A brand new brain with its own float
quiz.why: Sound and sight share Sense.

quiz.prompt: Moving Sense onto Tick keeps the hunter perfectly current. What cost shows up first?
choices: A physics query every frame from every idle hunter
quiz.why: The timer already asks often enough.

quiz.prompt: Alert becomes 1 only on a clear hit. Which node sits between the trace and that write?
choices: A branch on the hit bool
A flip of the patrol direction
quiz.why: The true pin is the clear look.

quiz.prompt: Begin Play in this graph does not look. What does it do?
quiz.why: The timer is the schedule.

quiz.prompt: True or false: a loud sound should call Sense instead of owning a second alert.
quiz.why: One brain.

quiz.prompt: True or false: a wall should still set Alert to 1 so the hunter stays suspicious.
quiz.why: A blocked trace is not a sighting.

quiz.prompt: The player crouches behind a crate that blocks the trace. What is Alert allowed to do?
choices: Jump to 1 because the player is nearby
quiz.why: No clear hit, no new sighting.

quiz.prompt: True or false: Sense should start from the player's use key.
quiz.why: Use is the player's graph. Sense is the hunter's.

interaction.plainEnglish: The player presses use and calls Interact on whatever the look hit. The hunter's Sense trace is not this graph and must not be pasted into it.
interaction.whyGame: If use also sets Alert, opening a fuse box aggros the hunter. If Sense is rewritten to call Interact, the hunter opens doors by looking at them.

expansions.title: Fuse box
expansions.detail: Interact on the box inserts a fuse. Sense never hears that call.

expansions.title: Hide lever
expansions.detail: A locker can answer Interact by starting a hide. The trace is still the player's.

expansions.title: Note
expansions.detail: A note answers Interact with text. It does not raise Alert.

quiz.prompt: Whose trace calls Interact in the dark?
choices: The player's, from the use key
quiz.why: Use is the player's press.

quiz.prompt: Graph_IA_Interact runs on a hit and calls ProcessEvent Interact. What must that line not assign?
choices: The call itself is all that line should do
A miss log when the bool is false
quiz.why: A broken sample assigns Alert inside the use function.

quiz.prompt: The true pin is taken. What runs?
choices: Interact on the actor that was hit
The hunter look should run because the player looked
quiz.why: True means a usable actor.

quiz.prompt: Pasting the Sense trace into the use graph makes the hunter open doors. Why?
choices: Sense would call Interact on whatever it sees
Alert cannot exist without a door
Saves require Sense to call Interact
quiz.why: The two traces ask different questions.

quiz.prompt: A fuse box and a hide locker both sit in the hall. How many use traces do you add?
choices: One that only hits fuses and one that only hits lockers
quiz.why: The interface already covers both.

quiz.prompt: The false pin logs a miss. A designer sets Alert there so darkness still scares the hunter. What went wrong?
choices: Missing a use is not a sighting
A missed grab should still spook the hunter
quiz.why: Alert is Sense's write.

quiz.prompt: True or false: the player's use graph and the hunter's Sense graph are different events.
quiz.why: Press versus timer.

quiz.prompt: True or false: Graph_IA_Interact should set Alert to 1.
quiz.why: That line belongs in Sense.

quiz.prompt: You rebind use to a shoulder button. What edits?
choices: The mapping context, not the trace
quiz.why: The graph does not know the button.

quiz.prompt: True or false: a missed use should still raise the hunter's Alert.
quiz.why: A miss is not a sighting.

stalk.plainEnglish: The hunter walks a route on a one-second timer. Alert from Sense is what pulls them off that route. The route itself is not stepped every frame.
stalk.whyGame: Stepping the route from Tick makes the hunter skate. Ignoring Alert means a clear sighting never becomes a chase.

expansions.title: Search
expansions.detail: After Alert falls, a search can walk back toward the last point. It is another timer, not Tick.

expansions.title: Leash
expansions.detail: Too far from the route, the hunter drops the chase and resumes AdvancePatrol.

expansions.title: Footsteps
expansions.detail: Footstep loudness can call Sense. The patrol function does not hear.

quiz.prompt: What walks the hunter along the route?
choices: A frame-by-frame skate along the points
quiz.why: Begin Play arms that timer.

quiz.prompt: GoingRight flips at the end of the route. What does that line change?
choices: Which way the next patrol step walks
Forcing a chase just by turning around
quiz.why: The flag is the route direction.

quiz.prompt: Alert becomes 1. What should the route timer allow next?
choices: A sighting should be ignored as decoration
quiz.why: Sense decides the sighting. The stalk decides to leave.

quiz.prompt: Tick steps the hunter so the chase feels smooth. What does the route look like?
choices: A slide, because the step no longer waits a second
quiz.why: The timer is the pace.

quiz.prompt: Begin Play in the patrol graph should not set Alert. What should it schedule?
choices: The route function on its timer
quiz.why: The route starts at spawn. The sighting does not.

quiz.prompt: A clear Sense expires and Alert falls. Where does the hunter go?
choices: Back to the route the timer already owns
They write the save every frame
quiz.why: The route is the home behavior.

quiz.prompt: True or false: AdvancePatrol is a timer, and Alert is what starts a chase.
quiz.why: Route and sighting are separate.

quiz.prompt: True or false: the patrol function should also set Alert when it flips direction.
quiz.why: Turning around is not a sighting.

quiz.prompt: The hunter is far from the route during a chase. What ends the chase without using Tick?
choices: A leash check on the chase event that resumes the patrol timer
quiz.why: The route is still the home.

quiz.prompt: True or false: Tick is required to move the hunter between patrol points.
quiz.why: The one-second timer is the step.

door.plainEnglish: Someone enters the volume, a timeline swings the door, and FlipFlop stores whether it is open. The creak is the sound of that swing.
door.whyGame: Yawing the door a degree per Tick never finishes a swing and never lines up with the creak that should alert the hunter.

expansions.title: Creak
expansions.detail: The creak can call Sense. The door does not set Alert itself.

expansions.title: Locked
expansions.detail: A locked door can ignore the overlap until Interact unlocks it.

expansions.title: Slam
expansions.detail: A second timeline can slam shut. It is still not a per-frame yaw.

quiz.prompt: What starts the door swing?
choices: Overlap, which then plays the timeline
quiz.why: Someone entered the volume.

quiz.prompt: PlayFromStart runs on the timeline component. What does the player hear if that call is skipped?
choices: No swing and no creak lined up with it
A correct creak with no motion
Sense setting Alert without a sound
quiz.why: The timeline is the motion and the cue.

quiz.prompt: FlipFlop writes IsOpen after the timeline starts. What does the next overlap do?
choices: Plays the curve the other way
quiz.why: FlipFlop alternates open and closed.

quiz.prompt: Yaw increases by one degree every frame. Why does the creak never match?
choices: There is no swing curve for the sound to follow
quiz.why: The timeline is the swing.

quiz.prompt: The creak should alert the hunter. Who sets Alert?
quiz.why: Sound shares Sense. The door does not own Alert.

quiz.prompt: A locked door uses Interact to unlock, then the volume swings it. How many yaw Ticks does that need?
choices: One per degree of the swing
quiz.why: The timeline replaces the yaw loop.

quiz.prompt: True or false: overlap should play the door timeline instead of adding yaw on Tick.
quiz.why: That is the graph.

quiz.prompt: True or false: FlipFlop should set Alert as well as IsOpen.
quiz.why: Alert is Sense's job.

quiz.prompt: IsOpen is saved. On continue, what should Begin Play restore?
choices: The bool, and then the timeline can show that pose
A full Tick yaw until the angle matches
quiz.why: The bool is the fact. The curve displays it.

quiz.prompt: True or false: the creak is a reason to move the door onto Tick.
quiz.why: The creak follows the timeline.

health.plainEnglish: This lesson is local health. Damage subtracts, a clamp keeps the number between zero and the max, and a branch notices zero. It is not the replicated authority lesson.
health.whyGame: Without the clamp, a big hit goes negative and the death check for exactly zero never fires. Putting this subtract on Tick drains the player in an empty hallway.

expansions.title: Bandage
expansions.detail: A bandage can add health through the same clamp. It is not a Tick regen.

expansions.title: Death
expansions.detail: The zero branch is the death. It should not also set Alert.

expansions.title: Later co-op
expansions.detail: The replicated lesson replaces this local write. Do not run both subtracts.

quiz.prompt: This horror health is local. What starts the subtract?
choices: A point of damage every frame
quiz.why: Damage is the event.

quiz.prompt: Health = Clamp(Health - Damage, 0, MaxHealth). What does the clamp save?
choices: A death check that looks for exactly zero
Whether the door is currently open
quiz.why: Negative health skips the zero branch.

quiz.prompt: After the clamp, which comparison notices death?
quiz.why: The branch is the death test.

quiz.prompt: Damage is subtracted with no clamp. The player took 50 with 10 health. Why might death never run?
choices: Health is -40, and the branch asked for zero
quiz.why: The check is equality with zero.

quiz.prompt: Tick subtracts one health so the house feels dangerous. What happens in an empty room?
choices: An empty room should stop the frame drain
quiz.why: Tick does not wait for a hit.

quiz.prompt: This lesson is not the replicated one. What should you not add yet?
choices: An authority gate and an OnRep that also subtracts
quiz.why: Local first. Replication is a different lesson.

quiz.prompt: True or false: local horror health should clamp after the subtract.
quiz.why: The clamp feeds the zero test.

quiz.prompt: True or false: this beginner health write belongs on the authority.
quiz.why: This lesson is local. Authority comes later.

quiz.prompt: A bandage adds 25. Where does the clamp still matter?
choices: It keeps the result from passing MaxHealth
quiz.why: The same clamp caps heals.

quiz.prompt: True or false: the death branch should also set the hunter's Alert.
quiz.why: Death is local health. Alert is Sense.

save.plainEnglish: Begin Play restores Alert, Health, and whether the door is open, together. The house does not write that snapshot from Tick.
save.whyGame: A Tick save stores a half-decayed Alert and a door mid-swing. Loading those three from different moments makes a continue that never happened.

expansions.title: Safe room
expansions.detail: The safe room calls the same struct write.

expansions.title: Continue
expansions.detail: Continue is Begin Play applying Alert, Health, and IsOpen.

expansions.title: New game
expansions.detail: New game skips the load. It does not Tick the fields back to defaults.

quiz.prompt: Which three facts does this house save together?
choices: The hunter's bone pose, the mouse, and the key code
Only the door yaw in degrees
quiz.why: Those are the lesson's facts.

quiz.prompt: Graph_BeginPlay_tpl_saveload_begin restores the house. What should it not redo?
choices: The chase that produced the saved Alert
quiz.why: Load applies results.

quiz.prompt: The struct is written when the timeline finishes or the player hits a save point. Why not every frame?

quiz.why: A finished event is the snapshot.

quiz.prompt: Tick stores Alert while Sense is still decaying. What continue do you get?
choices: A suspicion level the player never actually left behind
Health stuck at max because Tick heals

quiz.prompt: IsOpen loads true. How should the door show that without yawing on Tick?
choices: Pose the timeline to the open end
Add one degree per frame until it looks open

quiz.prompt: Why is the constructor too early for this load?
choices: The door, the hunter, and the health component may not exist yet
Begin Play runs before the constructor
quiz.why: Apply the slot onto actors that are already there.

quiz.prompt: True or false: Begin Play should restore Alert, Health, and IsOpen together.
quiz.why: One snapshot.

quiz.prompt: True or false: Tick should keep the horror slot current.
quiz.why: Tick catches unfinished values.

quiz.prompt: A safe-room volume and the pause menu both save. What do they share?
quiz.why: One shape.

quiz.prompt: True or false: continue should replay the chase that set Alert.
quiz.why: It applies Alert. It does not resimulate.
